description: List every ENA result type you can search — with its live record count and last-updated date — and, for one named result type, every field you may query or return. This is the schema-discovery step for ena_search: ENA rejects an unknown or wrong-result-type field name outright, so reading the field list first is cheaper than guessing. Also useful on its own for "how much public sequence data exists right now" — the counts are the archive's live totals.

result.description: Optional result type (e.g. read_run, study, sample) to also list its searchable/returnable fields. Omit to list result types only.

name: ena_results_types
title: Ena Results Types
